taskVersion.name: control-ves-nolabel-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 7.44 – 45 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive sandy layer between 7.44 m and 45 m depth as the primary aquifer zone; drill to at least 50 m to fully penetrate this layer and confirm whether the underlying high-resistivity unit (700 Ω·m) represents a productive fractured basement or a non-aquiferous bedrock.
